title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Jackson Suber wins RBC Canadian Open
items.text: Jackson Suber won the 2026 RBC Canadian Open at 13-under (197) after a final-round 66, edging Bud Cauley by one shot and earning a PGA Tour title plus significant FedExCup points.

items.headline: Brooks Koepka injury concern
items.text: Brooks Koepka faced an injury scare at a $9.8M event just a week before the U.S. Open, though he showed signs of returning to form after an extended adjustment on Tour.

items.headline: Alex Fitzpatrick on PGA pressure
items.text: Alex Fitzpatrick said earning his Tour card instantly brought pressure to prove himself, but after wins and strong finishes, he is now comfortable and playing confidently.
